localizedStory.de: In diesem schiefen Backsteinturm winden sich 498 Stufen fast 97 Meter empor — seit 1150 steht er über der Strada Maggiore.
localizedStory.en: Inside this leaning brick tower, 498 steps wind nearly 97 metres up. It has stood over Strada Maggiore since 1150.

fruits.name: Asinelli
fruits.story: Inside this leaning brick tower, 498 steps wind nearly 97 metres up. It has stood over Strada Maggiore since 1150.

localizedStory.de: Stolze Familien füllten Bologna einst mit hohen Steintürmen — dieser hier steht bis heute.
localizedStory.en: Proud families once filled Bologna with tall stone towers, and this one still stands tall.

fruits.name: Torre Azzoguidi
fruits.story: Proud families once filled Bologna with tall stone towers, and this one still stands tall.

localizedStory.de: Bolognas großer Treffpunkt seit 1550. Alte Paläste umringen ihn, und gleich daneben plätschert der Neptunbrunnen.
localizedStory.en: Bologna's great meeting place since 1550. Grand old palaces ring it, and Neptune's Fountain splashes just beside.

fruits.name: Piazza Maggiore
fruits.story: Bologna's great meeting place since 1550. Grand old palaces ring it, and Neptune's Fountain splashes just beside.

localizedStory.de: Bauern aus der Umgebung bringen frisches Obst, Käse und Brot auf diesen lebendigen Markt.
localizedStory.en: Farmers from the countryside bring fresh fruit, cheese and bread to sell at this weekly market.

fruits.name: Mercato Ritrovato
fruits.story: Farmers from the countryside bring fresh fruit, cheese and bread to sell at this weekly market.

localizedStory.de: Seit 1983 sammelt diese Bibliothek Bücher von und über Frauen — eine ganze Welt ihrer Geschichten.
localizedStory.en: Since 1983, this library has kept books by and about women — a whole world of their stories.

fruits.name: Biblioteca Italiana delle Donne
fruits.story: Since 1983, this library has kept books by and about women — a whole world of their stories.

localizedStory.de: Eine Kirche der Franziskaner-Brüder, hier seit 1236.
localizedStory.en: A church built by the friars of Saint Francis, standing here since 1236.

fruits.name: Basilica di San Francesco
fruits.story: A church built by the friars of Saint Francis, standing here since 1236.

localizedStory.de: Bolognas westliches Stadttor seit 1250, hin zur Via Emilia — der alten Römerstraße aus der Stadt.
localizedStory.en: Bologna's western gate since 1250, opening onto the Via Emilia — the old Roman road out of town.

fruits.name: Porta San Felice
fruits.story: Bologna's western gate since 1250, opening onto the Via Emilia — the old Roman road out of town.

localizedStory.de: Ein kleiner Platz an der alten Stadtmauer der Porta D'Azeglio — eine ruhige Pause dort, wo die Altstadt auf ihre Wälle trifft.
localizedStory.en: A little square tucked against the old Porta D'Azeglio walls — a quiet pause where the Old Town meets its ramparts.

fruits.name: Piazzetta Maurizio Cevenini
fruits.story: A little square tucked against the old Porta D'Azeglio walls — a quiet pause where the Old Town meets its ramparts.

localizedStory.de: Der Mercato delle Erbe verkauft seit 1950 Bolognas Gemüse und frische Lebensmittel. Folge den Farben und Gerüchen an der Via San Gervasio.
localizedStory.en: The Mercato delle Erbe has sold Bologna's greens and fresh food since 1950. Follow the colour and the smells off Via San Gervasio.

fruits.name: Mercato delle Erbe
fruits.story: The Mercato delle Erbe has sold Bologna's greens and fresh food since 1950. Follow the colour and the smells off Via San Gervasio.

localizedStory.de: Die Via Tagliapietre führt zu San Paolo Maggiore, der Kirche des Apostels Paulus. Der Bau begann 1606.
localizedStory.en: Via Tagliapietre leads to San Paolo Maggiore, the church of Saint Paul. Building began in 1606.

fruits.name: San Paolo Maggiore
fruits.story: Via Tagliapietre leads to San Paolo Maggiore, the church of Saint Paul. Building began in 1606.

localizedStory.de: Teatro Arena del Sole heißt 'Arena der Sonne'. Es wurde 1810 als Theater eröffnet, an der kleinen Piazzetta Dino Sarti.
localizedStory.en: The Arena del Sole means the 'Arena of the Sun'. It opened as a theatre in 1810, on the little Piazzetta Dino Sarti.

fruits.name: Teatro Arena del Sole
fruits.story: The Arena del Sole means the 'Arena of the Sun'. It opened as a theatre in 1810, on the little Piazzetta Dino Sarti.

localizedStory.de: Ein Stadttor seit 1250 — noch heute führt die alte Ausfallstraße an der Via Mascarella unter seinem Bogen hindurch.
localizedStory.en: A city gate since 1250 — the old road out of Bologna still slips beneath its arch on Via Mascarella.

fruits.name: Porta Mascarella
fruits.story: A city gate since 1250 — the old road out of Bologna still slips beneath its arch on Via Mascarella.

localizedStory.de: Die Piazza Aldrovandi trägt den Namen von Ulisse Aldrovandi. Geh hinüber, und die Basilica di Santo Stefano ist ein paar Minuten entfernt.
localizedStory.en: Piazza Aldrovandi takes its name from Ulisse Aldrovandi. Cross it and the Basilica di Santo Stefano is a few minutes away.

fruits.name: Piazza Aldrovandi
fruits.story: Piazza Aldrovandi takes its name from Ulisse Aldrovandi. Cross it and the Basilica di Santo Stefano is a few minutes away.

localizedStory.de: Bolognas Stadttor seit 1300, wo die Via Saragozza durch die alten Stadtmauern nach draußen führt.
localizedStory.en: Bologna's gate since 1300, where Via Saragozza steps out through the old city walls.

fruits.name: Porta Saragozza
fruits.story: Bologna's gate since 1300, where Via Saragozza steps out through the old city walls.

localizedStory.de: Ein prächtiges Stadttor seit 1650 — eines der alten Tore ins Herz Bolognas, nahe dem Teatro Arena del Sole.
localizedStory.en: A grand city gate since 1650 — one of the old doorways into Bologna, near the Arena del Sole theatre.

fruits.name: Porta Galliera
fruits.story: A grand city gate since 1650 — one of the old doorways into Bologna, near the Arena del Sole theatre.

localizedStory.de: Ein Stadttor seit 1286, das bis heute über den eigenen Platz wacht, nahe der Kirche Santa Maria dei Servi.
localizedStory.en: A city gate since 1286 that still stands over its own piazza, near the Santa Maria dei Servi church.

fruits.name: Porta San Vitale
fruits.story: A city gate since 1286 that still stands over its own piazza, near the Santa Maria dei Servi church.

localizedStory.de: Eine Kirche, die vor über tausend Jahren begonnen wurde, um 950 — nur einen kurzen Weg vom Turm der Asinelli.
localizedStory.en: A church begun over a thousand years ago, around 950 — a short walk from the Asinelli tower.

fruits.name: Basilica di Santo Stefano
fruits.story: A church begun over a thousand years ago, around 950 — a short walk from the Asinelli tower.

localizedStory.de: Die Universitätsbibliothek Bolognas, eröffnet 1712 — Regale voller alter Bücher im Universitätsviertel an der Via Zamboni.
localizedStory.en: Bologna's university library, opened in 1712 — shelves of old books in the university quarter on Via Zamboni.

fruits.name: Biblioteca Universitaria
fruits.story: Bologna's university library, opened in 1712 — shelves of old books in the university quarter on Via Zamboni.

localizedStory.de: Ein großes Theater seit 1750 — seine Musik erfüllt die Via dei Bibiena, neben der alten Universitätsbibliothek.
localizedStory.en: A grand theatre since 1750 — its music fills Via dei Bibiena, beside the old university library.

fruits.name: Teatro Comunale
fruits.story: A grand theatre since 1750 — its music fills Via dei Bibiena, beside the old university library.

localizedStory.de: Ein Torresotto ist eines von Bolognas kleineren inneren Stadttoren. Dieses überspannt noch die Via Castiglione, nahe der größeren Porta Castiglione.
localizedStory.en: A torresotto is one of Bologna's smaller inner gate-towers. This one still straddles Via Castiglione, near the bigger Porta Castiglione.

fruits.name: Torresotto di Via Castiglione
fruits.story: A torresotto is one of Bologna's smaller inner gate-towers. This one still straddles Via Castiglione, near the bigger Porta Castiglione.

localizedStory.de: Ein Stadttor seit 1350, wo die Straße nach Castiglione Bologna verließ — noch heute fasst es seinen Platz ein.
localizedStory.en: A city gate since 1350, where the road to Castiglione left Bologna — it still frames its own piazza.

fruits.name: Porta Castiglione
fruits.story: A city gate since 1350, where the road to Castiglione left Bologna — it still frames its own piazza.

streets.name: Via del Borgo di San Pietro
